document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
“Oh. Resign? Ahem. My dear fellow, I apologize! I should have 
recognized how serious you were. Go! Save poor Gliere’s hide. 
I know you’ll do it speedily and judiciously. The University will 
certainly pay for your round-trip ticket.” As you leave, you hear 
footsteps move quickly away from the door. But when you look 
out, the hallway is empty. Go to 82 or to any Arkham Location.
(100)
